raw_segments.text: After this I got embraced, told to wear flannel, be sure to write often, and so on and I left.
In the street, I don't know why a queer feeling came to me that I was an imposter.
Odd thing that I, who used to clear out for any part of the world at 24 hours notice,
with less thought than most men give to the crossing of a street, had a moment.
I won't say of hesitation but of startled pause before this commonplace affair.
The best way I can explain it to you is by saying that.
For a second or two, I felt as though, instead of going to the center of a continent,
I were about to set off for the center of the earth.
